name: @penguinharness/evo-harness-rsi-toolkit
description: Evo-Harness RSI Toolkit: reflect on negative feedback in the original Solver Session, compile one batch of reusable skills, then freeze and evaluate.

penguin.title: Evo-Harness RSI Toolkit
penguin.description_zh: 按 Evo-Harness 的负反馈反思与批次编译学习技能，通过 Penguin 原生子 Agent、State 和评测协议完成冻结对比。
penguin.short_description: Compile execution feedback into reusable skills.
penguin.short_description_zh: 从执行反馈按批次编译可复用技能。

quick_start.prompt: Use the selected Benchmark for Evo-Harness RSI, resolve this Project’s experiment settings, and autonomously complete learning, export, freezing and the Base/Skill comparison. Ask once for required missing inputs.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 使用指定 Benchmark 进行 Evo-Harness RSI；自动读取本项目已有实验配置，按冻结方法完成学习、导出、Base／Skill 对比和汇总，必要缺项集中询问一次。
